items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I said I did this Ricky Martin, “You worked with Ricky Martin?” he said.

ctx.x: I remember in the studio, I’m in the studio and I’ve got this music in front of me it says “She Bangs,” and like I’m the oldest guy in the horn section of the thing and I says, “Jesus, when I was a kid,” I said, “I never heard that expression.” I says, “The expression I heard when I was a kid was she gang bangs.” And I couldn’t believe that this thing was actually going to come out under that title. And all of a sudden the record came out and it’s called “She Bangs.” Right? That was the tune. And so I’m up at the…
Well this has really been fascinating talking to you.
